_meta.purpose: Benchmark Data Schema: define the fixture instance format for Visual Content Benchmark.
_meta.scope: Fixtures provide REAL content (lengths vary meaningfully) to prove content-aware layout works. Not placeholders.
_meta.usage: Each fixture is a full page Content Model instance. Layout-planner loads fixture by id, maps regions to template regions, renders real components.

field_specs.name: human readable name
field_specs.variant_notes: which content dimension this fixture stresses
field_specs.page_types: template page_types this fixture is valid for
field_specs.regions: Content Model instance regions (see content-schema.json), at least the regions the target template needs
